title: Kim Chiu speaks up after sister's arrest, says there's 'much more to this story'
summary: Actress Kim Chiu arrived Thursday at the Quezon City Hall of Justice for the arraignment of her sister Lakambini, who she charged with 124 counts of qualified theft.
